title: The Melting Snowman
text: On Saturday, a group of neighborhood kids spent the whole afternoon building an enormous snowman in the park. They decorated him with a carrot nose, two coal eyes, and a striped scarf. Overnight, the temperature dropped well below freezing, so the snowman stayed frozen solid. The next day, however, the sun came out and the temperature climbed above forty degrees. Because the air grew so much warmer, the snowman began to shrink hour by hour. By sunset, all that remained was a puddle of water and the carrot nose lying in the grass.
